title: Internship - Wholesale Banking Sector Coverage Telecom, Media, Technology & Healthcare team
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
ING is a global bank with a strong European base. Our 57,000 employees serve around 38.9 million customers, corporate clients, and financial institutions in over 40 countries. Our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and business. ING’s Wholesale Bank helps companies, institutions, and governments to gain access to capital in support of their success and further growth. We provide various services and products such as M&A & Capital Structuring advice, offer Financials Markets products, support daily payment requirements, and finance a variety of assets throughout the seven Sectors in which we’re organized. Through an internship in ING’s Sector organization, you’ll have the opportunity to get to know ING, a specific Sector and the services it provides, what it is like to be a full-time banker and whether this is an industry for you to pursue your career in.
TheTelecom, Media and Technology & Healthcare Sector Coverage teamoffers an exciting position in Amsterdam for an ambitious student who enjoys working in an international environment. The TMT & Healthcare sector team is one of the global specialist sector coverage teams at the heart of ING Wholesale Banking. We provide banking services and structure complex financing solutions (Debt and Debt advisory) to telecommunication, media, entertainment, technology, satellite, and healthcare companies in the EMEA region, the Americas, and Asia-Pacific. We have a broad client suite (investment and non-investment grade companies, private equity, infrastructure funds, etc.) which means you will get exposure to corporate, acquisition, capex, and project finance financing structures. We cooperate with various otherdepartmentswithin ING such as Corporate Finance, Sustainable Finance, Loan Distribution Group, Debt Capital Markets, Financial Markets, Transaction Services, and Risk Management.
Roles and responsibilities
The companies we cover in Amsterdam are active in the Telecommunication, Media, Entertainment, Technology, Satellite, and Healthcare sub-sectors. As an intern, you will be a member of multiple deal teams involved in transactions where you, for example, advise clients to finance data centers, fibre networks, or private hospitals. You work most closely together with team members in Amsterdam, but we also have TMT&H professionals in Frankfurt, Paris, Zurich, Madrid, Sydney, Singapore, Hong-Kong, Taiwan, Tokyo, Brussels, Milan and New York. As an Intern your job will be diverse, but your main tasks consist of the below:
Contribute to deal origination efforts by analyzing financial information, doing market research, peer group analysis, reviewing information memorandums and/or term sheets, and/or drafting commercial proposals
Assist in multiproduct pitches to TMT & Healthcare clients and presentations to relevant internal and external stakeholders for eg. subsector risk papers and deep-dive presentations
Assist in debt sizing, analysing different transaction (debt) structures and preparing business comparables
Assist in formulating client strategies and developing and maintaining close relationships with clients
Conduct research to support new and ongoing initiatives aimed at building sector expertise, exploring key drivers, competitors, products and macro trends
Support franchise growth by identifying prospective clients across the various subsectors and prepare business plan proposal(s)
Work closely with the senior management team and help organize client events or international (sub)sector conferences.
The complexity of the assignments, the dynamic environment combined with the international nature of the work and team will be a great start of your professional career. We aim to give you an experience that comes close to what you will be doing if you decide to pursue a career in banking.
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
Master student, preferably in the field of Economics, Econometrics, or Finance
Currently living or willing to relocate to Amsterdam/Randstad Area
Strong analytical and critical thinking (modelling and pitching skills are a plus), detail-oriented team-player who is proactive and takes responsibilities
Excellent interpersonal skills including communication, confidence in public speaking and (multidisciplinary) collaboration
Self-motivated and willing to work in a client centric and commercially driven environment
High proficiency in English (verbal and written), Dutch is a plus but not required
Familiar with MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel (familiarity with Capital IQ and researching tools are a plus)
Familiarity with the TMT or Healthcare sectors in Europe is helpful, a genuine interest is crucial
This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about your specialist area and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you.
You’ll also benefit from:
• Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on 36 hours work week
• Your own work laptop
• Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
• Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
• An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
During the duration of your internship at ING, it is mandatory to be enrolled at a Dutch university (or EU-university for EU passport holders).
The role concerns aHybrid role,for which you are required to bepresentin the office for aminimum of 4 days. We are looking forward to receiving yourCV and cover letter.Please don’t hesitate to be original and show who you really are. For any further questions please contact Patricia Santos (patricia.martins.santos@ing.com) and Gaston Rawsi Rost Onnes (gaston.rawsi.rost.onnes@ing.com).
About our internships
Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International Talent Programme (traineeship).
Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about many different aspects of banking – put simply, it’s a great start to your career.
We will be happy to amend the requisitions and post them online as soon as we receive the revised texts.
Please let us know if you have any further questions!
Thank you for your understanding!
